question: Total revenue by country, highest first
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Top 5 products by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders were returned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned'

question: Average order value by customer segment
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total, o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id) t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: Monthly revenue trend for 2025
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Revenue share by product category
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'completed') AS revenue_share FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which customer spent the most?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many unique customers placed orders in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31'

question: Customers in Kenya who bought electronics
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.country = 'Kenya' AND p.category = 'electronics'

question: The 5 most recently signed-up customers
gold_sql: SELECT name, signed_up FROM customers ORDER BY signed_up DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much revenue was lost to cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS lost_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: Total units sold per product category
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC
